title: إزالة مانع immutable diff
objective: إزالة whitespace فقط وتشغيل diff check بعد آخر كتابة.
rationale: يعالج السبب الجذري المسجل في findings المرتبطة ولا يكتفي بإسكات العارض.

preconditions.condition: تثبيت أحدث remote head قبل أي كتابة
preconditions.proof: GitHub branch head and commit object
preconditions.requiredState: SHA مطابق للرأس المتوقع ولا توجد حركة متزامنة غير مدمجة.

outOfScope: Production mutation or release without separate authorization.

changeSpecification.currentState: الحالة الحالية موثقة في findings والأدلة المرتبطة.
changeSpecification.targetState: diff check exits 0 after the implementation commit

exactChanges.implementationNotes: لا تغير السلوك أو صياغة الخطأ؛ تغيير تنسيق ذري.

forbiddenChanges: لا bypass عام، لا force push، لا مصدر حقيقة موازٍ، لا حذف بلا consumer census.
generatedArtifacts: Regenerate clients or ledgers only from canonical owners when affected.
consumerMigrations: Enumerate and migrate every direct consumer before deleting or renaming an interface.
dataMigrationSteps: Use fresh, upgrade, replay and data-preservation paths when persistence is affected.
compatibilitySteps: Keep compatibility only when an approved consumer still requires it and define removal evidence.
cleanupSteps: Remove obsolete artifacts only after reference search and target verification.
documentationUpdates: Update canonical owner or journey dossier; do not make this package the durable source.

commands.purpose: تنفيذ أصغر تحقق كافٍ بعد آخر كتابة.
commands.expectedObservableResult: diff check exits 0 after the implementation commit

positiveCriteria.statement: diff check exits 0 after the implementation commit
positiveCriteria.evidenceRequired: Command output and commit SHA after last write.

negativeCriteria: لا يبقى مسار قديم أو bypass أو فحص متخطى متعلق بالمهمة.
edgeCriteria: الحالات السلبية والـunknown result تختبر عندما تكون ضمن المجال.
mustRemainTrue: DSH owns operational truth; WLT owns financial truth; surfaces call DSH facade for DSH-related finance.

claimsNotProvenByTheseChecks: Production behavior unless a production-scoped authority and evidence are present.

triggerConditions: Required verification fails after the change.
Data preservation or contract compatibility is violated.
rollback.codeRollback: Revert only the atomic commit after capturing the failure evidence.
rollback.dataRollback: Use the service migration rollback/recovery procedure; never reverse an irreversible migration blindly.
rollback.contractRollback: Restore prior generated and owned contract state only with matching server and consumer state.
rollback.operationalRollback: Stop the affected profile and return to the last verified SHA.
